name: Strong, Inclusive and Competitive Economy
summary: A diversified, resilient and competitive upper-middle-income economy driven by macroeconomic stability, fiscal sustainability, a robust private sector and export-led industrialisation.

name: Human Capabilities and Social Development
summary: A healthy, well-educated, skilled, cohesive and socially protected society, with strong emphasis on STEM, universal health coverage, and inclusion of vulnerable groups.

name: Environmental Integrity and Climate Change Resilience
summary: Sustainable management of natural resources including biodiversity, wetlands and water, pollution and land management, and resilience to climate change.
